user.title: Sonarr & Radarr Library
user.description: Enter the URLs and API keys for your Sonarr and Radarr instances. The API key can be found under Settings > General in each app. Maintainerr is optional and has no API key (leave the URL blank to skip it).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the URL(s) and make sure Sonarr/Radarr/Maintainerr are reachable.

abort.already_configured: This Sonarr/Radarr combination is already configured.
